row.body: A repair sheet lists floorboards lifted for a crowd shelter, but the count of returned boards is higher than the count issued. One nail is still bent flat.
row.title: Under the boards

sidecar.gloss: A repair record and the remaining boards disagree about what was used.
sidecar.rival_reading: A storage crew could have reused boards for a work area; the mismatch does not establish a shelter order.
